name: Accounting Firm
description: Starter pack for an accounting or bookkeeping practice: client filing deadlines, payroll runs, trust account rules and tax season.

definitions.title: Daily client bank feed review
definitions.note: Review client bank feeds and clear duplicates.

definitions.title: Weekly deadline review
definitions.note: Scan all client filing deadlines for the next 30 days and flag at-risk ones.

definitions.title: Weekly billing and time entry
definitions.note: Enter time and raise client invoices.

definitions.title: Biweekly client payroll runs
definitions.note: Process client payroll batches and send remittance reports.

definitions.title: Monthly close for monthly clients
definitions.note: Close the previous month for monthly bookkeeping clients.

definitions.title: Monthly trust account reconciliation
definitions.note: Reconcile the trust account and file the working papers.

definitions.title: Quarterly instalment review
definitions.note: Review corporate and personal tax instalments for clients.

definitions.title: T4 and T5 slip preparation
definitions.note: Prepare and file T4, T4A and T5 slips for all clients.

definitions.title: Personal tax season preparation
definitions.note: Checklist review of the tax season pipeline and staffing.

definitions.title: Engagement letter renewals
definitions.note: Renew engagement letters and service scopes for all clients.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc new client onboarding
definitions.note: Onboard a new client - set the due date when creating it.
